headline: Abstraction Lab & MindsAI climbs from 78th to 23rd on ARC-AGI-3

sections.text: Abstraction Lab & MindsAI gained 4.05 to reach 37.83 on the ARC-AGI-3 public board, moving from 78th to 23rd in the past day.
The team is now outside the gold places, which are held at 19 with the gold line at 38.20, so it is close to the cutoff.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
